reaction.notes:
Updated with HTE-reported top-hit condition families (RuPhos–Pd G3/LiHMDS; BrettPhos–Pd G3/Cs2CO3 or LiHMDS; Pd2(dba)3/Me4tBuXPhos/LiHMDS; BINAP–Pd G3/Cs2CO3; XPhos–Pd G3/Cs2CO3). Use LiHMDS sets where substrate/FG compatibility allows; otherwise favor Cs2CO3 or K3PO4. Use this file ONLY if 'applies_if' tokens are present.
Then try base_rules (top→down). If none match, use default_rule.
After picking a rule, scan all modifiers and apply those that match (tokens OR plain‑text heuristics).
Notes: prefer ligand‑containing precatalysts (avoid Pd2(dba)3). Degas BEFORE adding base. 3 equiv base, 8 mol% Pd, ~10 vol solvent, start at 80 °C; for heteroaryl N-H start ~100 °C. Water (5–10 equiv) aids heterogeneous bases and scale‑up in apolar media.

applies_if.expr: (Ar-Br OR Ar-Cl OR Ar-F OR Ar-I OR Ar-OMs OR Ar-OTf OR Ar-OTs OR Vinyl-Br OR Vinyl-Cl OR Vinyl-F OR Vinyl-I OR Vinyl-OMs OR Vinyl-OTf OR Vinyl-OTs) AND ((Any-NH2 OR Ar-NH2 OR Bn-NH2 OR Allyl-NH2 OR Vinyl-NH2) OR (Any-NHR OR Ar-NHR OR Bn-NHR OR Allyl-NHR) OR (Indole OR Pyrrole OR Imidazole OR Pyrazole OR Triazole OR Tetrazole OR Benzimidazole OR Purine) OR (Any-CONHR OR Ar-CONHR))

default_rule.description: General starter for Buchwald–Hartwig C–N (weak aqueous base; ligand precatalyst).

conditions.pd_precatalyst: Buchwald precatalyst (allyl/crotyl > G1–G4 > LxPdCl2; avoid Pd2(dba)3)
conditions.temperature_C: 80 start (80–110 typical; heteroaryl N-H often 100 start)
conditions.time_h: 2–8 (if stalled after ~4 h, add 2–4 mol% Pd)
conditions.water_equiv: 5–10 when using heterogeneous bases or scaling in apolar media
conditions.atmosphere: N2 or Ar; degas before base addition

base_rules.name: Primary amines (aliphatic or aniline)
base_rules.description: Primary NH2 nucleophiles (aliphatic or aryl). First shot: t‑AmOH/Cs2CO3.

reactant_features.expr: (Any-NH2 OR Ar-NH2 OR Bn-NH2 OR Allyl-NH2 OR Vinyl-NH2)

conditions.base: K3PO4 (aq) or Cs2CO3; alt: NaOtBu or KHMDS (strong)

base_rules.name: Secondary amines
base_rules.description: Secondary NHR nucleophiles. Weak base often Cs2CO3; strong base if needed.

reactant_features.expr: (Any-NHR OR Ar-NHR OR Bn-NHR OR Allyl-NHR)

base_rules.name: Heteroaromatic NH (indoles, pyrazoles, etc.)
base_rules.description: Heteroaryl N–H coupling; heteroaryl N-H often needs hotter start (~100 °C).

reactant_features.expr: Indole OR Pyrrole OR Imidazole OR Pyrazole OR Triazole OR Tetrazole OR Benzimidazole OR Purine

base_rules.name: Amides (CONH2 / CONHR)
base_rules.description: Low‑nucleophilicity N; stronger ligand systems helpful.

when: symptom:heterogeneous base (carbonate/phosphate) or scale‑up in apolar solvent
modifiers.suggest: Add 5–10 equiv H2O or use a more polar co‑solvent to aid mass transfer.
Degas the solution BEFORE adding base; maintain N2/Ar atmosphere.
Switch to a less active system (e.g., XantPhos or QPhos).
Charge an additional 2–4 mol% Pd precatalyst.
Prefer allyl/crotyl precatalysts > Buchwald G1–G4 > LxPdCl2. Avoid Pd2(dba)3.
Use milder base (K3PO4(aq) or Cs2CO3), reduce H2O, and/or lower temperature.
Favor MeCN or t‑AmOH; avoid very apolar media.
Favor toluene or dioxane; consider biphasic dioxane/H2O for bases.
Increase Pd loading (e.g., +2–4 mol%) and/or use a stronger donor ligand (tBuBrettPhos).
Protect/remove thiol (e.g., Ag2O scavenging) or adjust conditions; strong Pd binding expected.
Prioritize RuPhos–Pd G3/LiHMDS or BrettPhos–Pd G3/LiHMDS in dioxane (80–105 °C). If strong base incompatible, try BrettPhos–Pd G3/Cs2CO3.
Favor dialkylbiaryl systems at ≥100 °C: RuPhos–Pd G3/LiHMDS or BrettPhos–Pd G3/LiHMDS; otherwise BrettPhos–Pd G3/Cs2CO3 or XPhos–Pd G3/Cs2CO3.
Test LiHMDS sets (RuPhos–Pd G3/LiHMDS; BrettPhos–Pd G3/LiHMDS).
Include BINAP–Pd G3/Cs2CO3 (dioxane, ~90–105 °C) among trials; often ranks in top‑hits with milder profile.
